plugins.name: co-scientist
plugins.description: Generate, debate, Elo-rank and evolve novel hypotheses for hard, open-ended goals (Google AI Co-Scientist replica).

plugins.name: co-scientist-lab
plugins.description: Co-Scientist plus an Experiment agent: runs each idea through your project's own command and ranks on measured results. Asks a few setup questions, then loops for N rounds or until your target metric is hit.
